definitions.explanation: Food that has not been cooked thoroughly, leaving the inside raw or partially raw. Can also be used figuratively to describe something incomplete or half-done.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{生焼|なまや}けだ。
{生焼|なまや}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鶏肉|とりにく}→鶏肉：02919_toriniku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}→食中毒：07020_shokuchuudoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Undercooked chicken can cause food poisoning.

examples.japanese: ⟦ハンバーグ→ハンバーグ：01785_hanbaagu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{生焼|なまや}けだった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧ことにした。
examples.english: The inside of the hamburger steak was still undercooked, so I decided to cook it a bit more.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧ (raw) and ⟦{焼|や}け→焼ける：01138_yakeru⟧ (burning/cooking). Describes food that appears cooked on the outside but remains raw or insufficiently cooked on the inside. This is an important concept in food safety, especially with meats.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生焼|なまや}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧: undercooked meat
- {生焼|なまや}け⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: undercooked state
- ⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{生焼|なまや}け: undercooked inside

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧: raw — completely uncooked
- ⟦レア→レア：11251_rea⟧: rare (cooking term) — borrowed from English; intentionally served lightly cooked
- ⟦{焼|や}き→焼く：01123_yaku⟧すぎ: overcooked — too much cooking, the opposite problem
- ⟦{半生|はんなま}→半生：24441_hannama⟧: half-raw / semi-dried — can mean partially raw food or half-dried products like noodles
